thought.text: Login worked again. Let me follow the callback to the app with the session.

reasoning_content: The cookie jar shows no cookies, which is strange since I'm expecting to capture the code_verifier cookie from oauth2-proxy. Let me look at the actual response headers from the initial request to see what's happening, since the grep filter might be hiding something or the cookie format could be different.

action.command:
cd /tmp
CALLBACK=$(curl -s -b c.txt -c c.txt -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' \
  "http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback?state=WeckimIWz1xhNdK-p8y9oORchlJM5UkG4IhIkeh3Ghk%3A%2Fapp%2F&session_state=1a535c77-57c4-4b36-b199-a322388d74a8&iss=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A9090%2Frealms%2Flocal&code=3c95f04f-af61-4951-894a-b12093f9b2a9.1a535c77-57c4-4b36-b199-a322388d74a8.c64e6eb3-c47e-4f21-8ff4-0111d9f4335b")
echo "callback -> $CALLBACK"
echo "cookies now:"; grep -vE '^\#' c.txt | awk '{print $6}'
# Step 5: GET the final app URL
FINAL="${CALLBACK:-http://localhost:3000/app/}"
curl -s -b c.txt -c c.txt -o app2.html -w 'GET app: %{http_code} final=%{url_effective}\n' -L "$FINAL"
echo "title:"; grep -oE '<title>[^<]*</title>' app2.html | head -1
echo "SPARK count:"; grep -oc "SPARK" app2.html
echo "app size:"; wc -c app2.html
